name: Spider-Man
diceAnatomy: 1-3 = Thwip (A), 4-5 = Web (B), 6 = Spider (C). Vérifié leaflet (scan user 2026-07-06).
source: Board + leaflet + 14 cartes scannés user 2026-07-06. Spec complète : characters/Spider_Man/SPEC.md. Rulings user : Spider-Sense 'On Spider' = une fois si >=1 Spider ; défenseur choisit librement entre les 2 défenses ; Combo = Offensive Roll Phase complète additionnelle.

tokens.name: Combo
tokens.description: Unique Status Effect. If your Offensive Roll Phase resulted in an Attack, you may spend this token at the conclusion of your opponent's Defensive Roll Phase: immediately target the same opponent with an additional Offensive Roll Phase. Can only spend once per turn. Not transferable.

tokens.name: Webbed
tokens.description: Negative Status Effect. When inflicted, deal 2 as an isolated source of undefendable dmg. The next time the afflicted player is Attacked with normal damage, the damage becomes undefendable instead and this token is removed.

tokens.name: Invisibility
tokens.description: Unique Status Effect. When Attacked with an undefendable Attack, may spend this token to activate a Defensive Ability. Not transferable. Also fuel for Ambush!/Nice Try!/Spider-Sense extra Roll Attempt.

abilities.notes: Roll 2 dice and deal dmg equal to the total roll value (E=7). If the final roll value is 5 or less, gain Combo.
Deal dmg, THEN inflict Webbed (les 2 iso dmg du jeton tombent après l'attaque).
Draw 1. Deal dmg. Then inflict Webbed.
Gain Invisibility. Inflict Webbed. Then deal 13 dmg (Ultimate = indéfendable).

altAbilities.notes: Gain Invisibility. Inflict Webbed (les 2 iso dmg du jeton = seule source de dégâts).
Gain Combo. Then deal 2 undefendable dmg.

defense.name: Spider-Sense / Counterpunch
defense.text: Spider-Sense — Defense Roll 2: On Spider, prevent 1/2 dmg (rounded up), une fois (ruling user). You may discard Invisibility to take an additional Roll Attempt. Counterpunch — Defense Roll 3: Deal 1 dmg x Thwip.

cards.name: Punch II
cards.text: AAA: 5. AAAA: 6. AAAAA: 7. On 4-of-a-kind (#'s), gain Combo.

cards.name: C-C-C-Combo II
cards.text: AACC: Deal 6 dmg. Gain Combo. Adds alt WEB SHOT (BBC): Gain Invisibility. Inflict Webbed.

cards.name: Ensnare II
cards.text: Small Straight: 6 dmg, then inflict Webbed. Large Straight: Draw 1, 9 dmg, then inflict Webbed.

cards.name: Venom Punch II
cards.text: CCCC: Gain Invisibility. Deal 8 undefendable dmg. Adds alt COMBO UP (CCC): Gain Combo. Then deal 2 undefendable dmg.

cards.name: Swing Escape!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Your Spider-Sense Defensive Ability succeeds on Web instead of Spider (this card can be played after your dice have been rolled).

cards.name: Nice Try!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Play only after being Attacked. Discard Invisibility: prevent 3 dmg.

cards.name: Invisible Punch!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action. Play only after being Attacked. If you prevented dmg via Spider-Sense, deal 3 dmg.

cards.name: Ambush!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action, Attack Modifier. Discard Invisibility: add 3 dmg.

cards.name: Web Shooters!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Inflict Webbed on a chosen player.

cards.name: Booyah!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Roll 1 die: On Thwip, gain Invisibility. On Web, inflict Webbed. On Spider, gain Combo.
